operators.name: custom_abs
semantics: Input must be a contiguous CUDA tensor of dtype torch.float32 and shape [16, 3, 2048, 2560].
Output has identical shape, dtype (torch.float32), and device; allocation uses torch::empty_like equivalent.
Corresponds to reference step_001: x = torch.abs(x).

operators.name: custom_floor
semantics: Input must be a contiguous CUDA tensor of dtype torch.float32 and shape [16, 3, 2048, 2560].
Output has identical shape, dtype (torch.float32), and device.
Corresponds to reference step_002: x = torch.floor(x).
Element-wise absolute value applied to input tensor x of shape [16, 3, 2048, 2560], dtype float32, device cuda.
Produces tensor of same shape, dtype, and device with all negative values replaced by their absolute values.
Element-wise floor applied to the result of step_001 (absolute values).
Produces tensor of same shape, dtype, and device with each value rounded down to the nearest integer.
Returns the final tensor from step_002, shape [16, 3, 2048, 2560], dtype float32, device cuda.
